conoceme.introQuote: I'm <c1>Rafa</c1>. My approach as a <c2>Frontend</c2> developer is to build interfaces where performance and aesthetics go hand in hand. I come from the audiovisual industry, a stage that taught me to care about visual detail, but today my priority is the <c3>technical solution</c3>. I use tools like <c4>React and TypeScript</c4> to create fast, accessible websites with a refined design. I don't chase the standard — I seek the balance between clean code and an impeccable <c5>user experience</c5>.
conoceme.title: README.md

passion.heading:
Where Creativity
Meets Code
passion.p1: After more than ten years in the audiovisual sector, I understood that an interface is not just an image, but a <c1>functional system</c1>. My current work is about bringing that visual rigor to <c2>Frontend</c2> development.
passion.p2: I don't see code as a career change, but as the ability to <c1>build my own tools</c1>. I went from capturing reality with a camera to programming scalable, efficient interactive experiences.
passion.p3: Today, my focus is technical balance: using <c1>React and TypeScript</c1> to create products that are robust on the inside and flawless on the outside. I strive for clean code as the foundation of a <c2>superior user experience</c2>.

studio.subtitle: Behind The Mix
studio.title: STUDIO <c1>SESSIONS</c1>
studio.intro: Knowing the tools isn't enough. What defines my work is <c1>how I apply them</c1>: testing, performance, accessibility, and architecture as part of the process, not afterthoughts.

01.title: Testing
01.details: Vitest + Testing Library. Render, behavior, and form tests. Shared Framer Motion mock to avoid duplication across specs.

02.title: Architecture
02.details: Feature-based structure, custom hooks, global state with Zustand/Context, separation of business logic and UI. Reusable modular components.

03.title: Performance
03.details: Lazy routes with React.lazy, WebP images with picture element, font preloading, preload="none" on videos, native lazy loading. Lighthouse 95+.

04.title: Code Quality
04.details: Strict TypeScript, ESLint with custom rules, Git workflows with branches and PRs, continuous deployment on Netlify. Code stays clean by convention, not supervision.

05.title: Accessibility
05.details: Skip-to-content, focus traps in modals and menus, descriptive aria-labels, ARIA roles, prefers-reduced-motion respect. Keyboard navigable.

06.title: Deployment
06.details: Netlify with CI/CD, automatic build optimization, SEO with schema.org and Open Graph, sitemap, meta descriptions, and semantic structure.

weddingAlbum.title: Wedding Album System
weddingAlbum.desc: Interactive digital invitation for events that centralizes all information, the couple's story, and a real-time collaborative gallery accessible via QR.
weddingAlbum.context: Project developed for a real wedding with the need to centralize information, manage guests, and share memories without relying on multiple tools.
weddingAlbum.problem: Event information, guest management, and photos were scattered across different channels, creating friction for both the couple and guests.
solution: Digital invitation with all event information
Direct links to key locations (Google Maps)
Section with the couple's story
Gallery where guests can view, upload, and download photos
Frictionless private area access via QR
Confirmation form connected to Google Sheets
Client-side image compression for better performance
Design optimized for quick mobile use
weddingAlbum.result: Guests accessed all information from a single place and shared photos in real time, while the couple managed confirmations automatically without manual processes.
weddingAlbum.impact: Validated in a real environment with non-technical users.

skyRESERVE.title: skyRESERVE
skyRESERVE.desc: Drone service booking platform (web + mobile app) with authentication, admin panel, and real-time availability.
skyRESERVE.context: Complete web and mobile app system with real Supabase backend. Manages the full drone booking cycle: from a client requesting a flight to the pilot completing the mission. Data persists in the database, authentication protects routes, and roles determine what each user can see.
skyRESERVE.problem: Manual management of drone service bookings caused scheduling confusion, mission overlaps, and lack of control over each operation's status.
solution: Real Supabase backend: auth, database, and Row Level Security
Role-based authentication: admin sees everything, pilot sees missions, client sees bookings
Availability calendar with real-time slot locking on booking
Mission status with transitions: planned → confirmed → in flight → completed
Global state with Zustand for panel synchronization
Native mobile app (iOS/Android/Web) with React Native and Expo
Unit and integration tests with Vitest
Netlify deployment with optimized build
skyRESERVE.result: Production application (web + mobile app) that replaces manual management with a system where the client books online, the admin assigns pilot/drone, and status updates in real time. No emails, no WhatsApp, no confusion.
skyRESERVE.impact: Full-stack architecture with real backend, auth, roles, persistence, and native mobile version — not a tutorial CRUD, but a product with cross-platform business logic.

thePueblo.title: The Pueblo
thePueblo.desc: Visual experience built to support heavy audiovisual content without breaking fluidity or load times.
thePueblo.context: Project for an audiovisual production company where content (images and video) is the product. The priority was not adding functionality, but ensuring the experience stayed fast even with heavy assets.
thePueblo.problem: High-quality content (video + extensive galleries) quickly degrades performance: high load times, render blocks, and loss of navigation fluidity.
solution: Progressive loading: static image as placeholder before video
Lazy video loading activated only on interaction
Separation of visual layers and logic to avoid unnecessary re-renders
Font optimization to eliminate layout shift
Manual playback control to avoid unnecessary consumption
Lightweight animations (CSS/AOS) instead of heavy JS
thePueblo.result: The website maintains a fluid feel even when handling heavy content, avoiding blocks and reducing perceived load time.
thePueblo.impact: Allows showcasing high-quality audiovisual content without sacrificing performance — critical in projects where visuals are the product.

nor3xtrem.title: Nor3xtrem
nor3xtrem.desc: Real-time consultation platform for a cyclotourism event, optimized to work under high user load and limited connectivity.
nor3xtrem.context: System developed for a large-scale cyclotourism event, where thousands of users simultaneously access critical information during the event.
nor3xtrem.problem: In high-traffic environments with irregular coverage, access to key information (routes, regulations, rankings) had to remain stable, fast, and accessible without relying on optimal connections.
solution: Lightweight SPA architecture with React to minimize overhead
Optimized build with Vite for minimal load times
Mobile-first design for on-road use
High-contrast interface for outdoor visibility
Modular structure to prevent render blocks
Smooth animations with Framer Motion without affecting performance
nor3xtrem.result: Platform capable of handling traffic spikes in real event conditions, maintaining stable access to critical information at all times.
nor3xtrem.impact: Used in a real high-demand environment, demonstrating reliability under limited connectivity and simultaneous mass usage.

armarioEscenico.title: Armario Escénico
armarioEscenico.desc: Digital stage costume consultation system that replaces a physical archive, optimizing search and selection of garments for professional use.
armarioEscenico.context: Project developed to digitize a real costume archive used in stage productions, where consultation relied on physical and inefficient systems.
armarioEscenico.problem: Manual inventory management made locating a specific garment require slow searches dependent on memory or physical archive review.
solution: Advanced filtering system by attributes (period, type, material)
Render optimization with useMemo for large data volumes
Selection persistence with localStorage for work continuity
Modular component architecture for catalog scalability
Mobile-first interface for quick workplace consultation
armarioEscenico.result: Transforms a physical archive into an agile consultation tool, significantly reducing the time needed to locate and select costumes in production processes.
armarioEscenico.impact: Converts a physical costume search process into an immediate digital query, streamlining production work and garment selection.

infraRD.title: Infra.RD
infraRD.desc: Observability system that monitors multiple web services, detecting outages and automatically alerting via email.
infraRD.context: Internal tool for continuously supervising endpoint status. Every 60 seconds it runs health checks against configured services and stores results in Supabase.
infraRD.problem: Without centralized monitoring, a service outage could go unnoticed for hours until a user manually reported it.
solution: Automated health checks every 60 seconds via cron jobs
Historical latency and status logging in Supabase
Automatic email alert system for critical failures
Scenario simulation (OK / DOWN / TIMEOUT) for testing
Dashboard with quick overview: uptime, average latency, current status
Decoupled architecture: monitoring engine separate from UI
infraRD.result: Detects and notifies incidents in under 60 seconds, eliminating reliance on manual checks and reducing reaction time to failures.
infraRD.impact: Moves from detecting outages via user reports to detecting them automatically before they impact the business.

matterSound.title: Matter & Sound
matterSound.desc: Real-time audio visualizer that transforms frequencies into generative particle systems on Canvas.
matterSound.context: Experimental project that connects the browser microphone to a visual rendering engine. Audio is processed client-side via the Web Audio API and rendered as particles reacting to rhythm.
matterSound.problem: Processing real-time audio signals and rendering particles on Canvas without blocking React's main thread, while maintaining smooth animation.
solution: Frequency analysis via FFT with Web Audio API
Particle rendering on HTML5 Canvas outside React's rendering cycle
useRef to isolate the animation loop from rendering
Complete separation of audio layer and visual engine
Memory management to prevent leaks in long sessions
matterSound.result: Visualization engine that processes audio in real time and renders dynamic visual structures without perceptible performance drops.
matterSound.impact: Demonstrates mastery of browser APIs below React's level: signal processing and low-level rendering.

edMovil.title: ED Movil
edMovil.desc: Telecommunications website commissioned by a real client to compare and contract fiber, mobile, and TV services.
edMovil.context: Real commission for a telecommunications provider that needed to replace their old website with a clearer, more direct experience. Goal: users compare, decide, and contact without friction.
edMovil.problem: The old website was losing clients because information was disorganized and the contact process was confusing. Users left without contacting.
solution: Visual comparison structure with highlighted plans and prices
Contact forms with client-side validation
Mobile-first design for intensive smartphone use
Automated tests with Vitest and Testing Library
CI/CD configured to detect regressions before deployment
edMovil.result: Website deployed and in production that the client actively uses to capture leads. Comparison → decision → contact flow reduced to 3 clear steps.
edMovil.impact: Real commission with paying client. The project was evaluated by conversion capability, not technical complexity.

amMovilRepair.title: AM Movil Repair
amMovilRepair.desc: Technical service website commissioned by a real business to digitize their presence and attract clients.
amMovilRepair.context: Real commission for a mobile repair service with no digital presence. The client needed a website where users could find the location, see what they repair, and contact directly.
amMovilRepair.problem: Without a website, potential customers relied on Google Maps or word of mouth to find the service. Many clients never made contact.
solution: Interactive map with exact business location (Google Maps API)
Simplified contact form with essential fields
Responsive design optimized for mobile searches
Structure focused on a single action: contact
Fast loading to not lose impatient users
amMovilRepair.result: Website deployed at ammovilrepair.com and in active use. The client receives direct contacts through the form without relying on social media.
amMovilRepair.impact: Real commission with own domain. Transforms scattered searches into direct contacts with an interface that doesn't give users time to leave.

rdisquetePhoto.title: Web RDisquete Photo
rdisquetePhoto.desc: Personal photography portfolio with galleries of original series and immersive navigation.
rdisquetePhoto.context: Personal photography portfolio with real, original images. Each series is a different visual project (weddings, portraits, nature) and the interface is designed to fade away and let the image fill the screen.
rdisquetePhoto.problem: Displaying extensive photo series without the interface competing for attention or disrupting the navigation rhythm between images.
solution: Reusable galleries with keyboard and touch navigation
Carousels with smooth transitions and manual control
Pure CSS for photo transition animations
Lazy image loading for progressive loading
Minimalist layout eliminating all visual distraction
rdisquetePhoto.result: Deployed and active portfolio that serves as a professional showcase for photographic work, with series organized by project.
rdisquetePhoto.impact: Combines my audiovisual background with frontend development — demonstrates that I not only write code but understand visual composition and narrative.
